references.text: Moses answers and confirms their promise to build cities for the children and enclosures for the small livestock, as they proposed in verse 16.
The fulfillment of the promise from verse 16, where the children of Gad build the fortified cities and enclosures for the small livestock.
The background for the request - the children of Reuben and Gad had much cattle, which explains the need for enclosures mentioned in verse 16.
Jacob also built enclosures for his flocks at Succoth, a similar example of building protection for livestock.
The continuation of their promise, where they also vow to arm themselves and fight before the children of Israel.
